description: Almost everything mirrors. Transport controls do not. Rewind, play and stop refer to the direction a tape moves, not to the direction a language is read, and reversing them puts rewind on the right of play in a language where that means the opposite of what it says. Microsoft and Apple both say leave them. So the group moves to the mirrored side of the form as a block and keeps its internal order: the block spans 20 to 220 and the form is 400 wide, so it lands at 180 to 380 with rewind still first. An ordinary button beside it mirrors as usual, which is what shows the exception is an exception rather than the whole rule quietly switched off.
